result:
I shipped nothing for this task. One of the two defects is already gone, and the other is a copy his own order requires. I didn't take fresh pictures or re-run the checks this time. I relied on the earlier run's notes (pictures from v34.31) and found nothing on HEAD that reopens them.

- **Right column overlap (screen 34):** gone. The earlier run's 1080p and 4K pictures show no two text boxes in the right column touching. There was no separate P2 shot, because P1 and P2 use the same layout code.
- **Alert drawn more than once (screen 33):** it is two copies now, not three. "the pillbox has seen you" shows as the red banner and again as a row in the left feed. "location revealed" and "running slowly" are likewise a top-centre row plus a feed row. The cause is that every line said on screen also goes into the player feed, which is his 10-15 order (cw-feedall). Removing the copies would reverse it, so I left them and logged the question.
- **Critic scores:** both screens scored 2 on the earlier run, and I have not re-scored them. Screen 34's main finding is that the downed card is a flat box rather than the standard panel, with the run info rows wrapping. Screen 33's are the duplicate alerts, a controls cheat-sheet in the centre of the screen, and the red tint over the whole frame.
- **Not done:** restyling the downed card and fixing the run info wrap. That is real work and needs its own task.

I appended this to `tools/handoff/console/notes/106-ui-raid-column-overlaps.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: the right-column overlap is already fixed on HEAD and the repeated alert is his own order, but both screens still score 2 (target 4). The downed card restyle and the run info wrap need their own task.
